items.summary: Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel has defended a joke in which he called First Lady Melania Trump an "expectant widow", just days before a shooting incident at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.
items.summary_zh: 深夜主持人吉米·金梅尔(Jimmy Kimmel)为一个笑话辩护,他在笑话中称第一夫人梅拉尼亚·特朗普为"预期中的寡妇",就在白宫记者晚宴的枪击事件前几天.

items.title: Former US officials criticise Pentagon silence on deadly Iran school attack
items.title_zh: 前美国官员批评五角大楼对致命的伊朗学校袭击保持沉默
items.summary: Five former US officials, including a former top military lawyer, have criticised the Pentagon for not acknowledging potential American involvement in a deadly strike on an Iranian school earlier this year.
items.summary_zh: 包括一位前高级军事律师在内的五名前美国官员批评五角大楼不承认美国可能参与今年早些时候对一所伊朗学校的致命袭击。

items.title: Kim Jong Un praises troops who 'self-blasted' to avoid capture by Ukraine
items.title_zh: 金正恩称赞军队"自爆",避免被乌克兰俘虏.
items.summary: Kim Jong Un has praised North Korean soldiers who killed themselves by detonating their grenades while fighting for Russia against Ukraine, confirming a long-suspected battlefield policy.
items.summary_zh: 金正 乌恩赞扬了朝鲜士兵自相残杀,在为俄罗斯出战乌克兰时引爆了手榴弹,证实了长期怀疑的战场政策.

items.title: Comey charged with threatening Trump's life in Instagram post
items.title_zh: 科米被控威胁特朗普在Instagram的生平
items.summary: Former FBI Director James Comey has been charged with threatening the life of US President Donald Trump, a formal accusation that stems from an image he briefly shared on social media.
items.summary_zh: 前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米(James Comey)被指威胁美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的生命,这一正式指控源于他在社交媒体上短暂分享的一幅相片.

items.title: Trump's face to feature on commemorative US passports
items.title_zh: 特朗普在纪念美国护照上的面孔
items.summary: The US will release a limited number of passports that feature a portrait of US President Donald Trump, the White House has confirmed.
items.summary_zh: 美国将发行数量有限的护照,上面有美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的肖像,白宫已经确认.

items.title: A faraway conflict threatens livelihoods in India's glass hub
items.title_zh: 遥远的冲突威胁到印度玻璃枢纽的生计
items.summary: Tensions in the Middle East are rippling far beyond the region - and are now being felt in India's "glass city" Firozabad, where thousands of jobs are at risk.
items.summary_zh: 中东的紧张局势正在远远地蔓延到该地区以外地区,现在在印度的"玻璃城市"菲罗扎巴德(Firozabad),那里有上千个工作面临危险。

items.title: Watch: Elderly woman rescued by robot from Ukraine's frontline
items.title_zh: 观察:被机器人从乌克兰前线救起的老年妇女
items.summary: Footage shared by Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps showed the moment an elderly woman trying to leave her wrecked village was rescued by a robot.
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰第3军团共享的脚印显示了一位想离开被破坏村庄的老年妇女被机器人救出的时刻.

items.title: US regulator to review Disney broadcast licences after Jimmy Kimmel joke about Melania Trump
items.title_zh: 美国监管者审查迪士尼的广播许可,
items.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission is ordering an early review of Disney's television broadcast licences days after President Donald Trump called for the firing of late-night host Jimmy Kimmel.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦通信委员会在唐纳德·特朗普总统呼吁解雇深夜主持人吉米·金梅尔后数日下令提前审查迪士尼的电视广播许可证.

items.title: Indian billionaire's son offers to save Escobar's hippos
items.title_zh: 印度亿万富翁的儿子愿意拯救埃斯科瓦尔的河马
items.summary: An Indian billionaire's son has offered to help Colombia get rid of a problem it has grappled with for years - a herd of hippos linked to notorious drug lord Pablo Escobar.
items.summary_zh: 一位印度亿万富翁的儿子提出要帮助哥伦比亚摆脱一个多年来一直困扰的问题,

items.title: Faisal Islam: Why the UAE's exit from Opec is a big deal
items.title_zh: 费萨尔伊斯兰教: 阿联酋为何要退出奥佩克?
items.summary: It is a very big deal that the United Arab Emirates (UAE) has announced its abrupt exit from Opec , the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries. The Emiratis were members even before they became a nation state in 1971.
items.summary_zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国宣布突然退出石油输出国组织Opec,这是一件大事。 酋长国在1971年成为民族国家之前就已经是成员。

items.title: US political violence generates a familiar cycle - this time it's in overdrive
items.title_zh: 美国的政治暴力造成了一种熟悉的循环——这次是过度驱动
items.summary: For many in the ballroom at the White House Correspondents' Association dinner on Saturday night, the scene was painfully familiar. Shots fired, confusion and panic, and a sense that the normal order of things had been violently interrupted.
items.summary_zh: 对于在白宫记者协会周六晚宴会的舞厅里的许多观众来说,场景令人痛苦地熟悉. 枪声响起,混乱和恐慌,感觉正常的秩序被粗暴地打断.
